parsed.notes:
The test set from ~/llm-bench is now in crates/core/src/described_cases.json. An #[ignore] live test (`cargo test -p calendar-core the_test_set_against_a_live_ollama -- --ignored --nocapture`) ran here against a real Ollama with gemma4:e4b: dates 100 %, every field 93 %. TC-10-19 stays the owner's manual check.
DEC-222: TC-10-15 step 3 expects the saved event only in the local file, but the app also keeps a copy in cache.sqlite3 for the views. The test checks that the title is only in those two files and that the description and the answer are in no file and no output. The TC was not edited; whether it should name the cache is for the analyst.
TC-10-15 runs the app in a child test process, which other tests do not do. TC-10-17 step 2 sets the window's calendar in the test instead of clicking the picker. TC-10-04 checks requests through the fake Google and fake Ollama records, not a network-wide capture.
